lines.text: David asks the LORD to hear his prayer and not bring him into judgment, since no one alive is righteous.
The enemy crushes David's life to the ground and makes him dwell in a cave, and his spirit grows faint.
David remembers the days of old, considers the work of God's hands, and stretches out his hands to God.
David asks God not to hide His face, lest he be like sheep without a shepherd, and asks for teaching.

wrong_details.true: those who descend to the Pit

lines.text: David flees to God for refuge, asks to be taught God's will, and asks God to cut off his enemies.
